heading: System integrations. Workflow automation. Expert bookkeeping.
body: McCullough Clark is an operations firm for businesses built on expertise. We keep the books, connect the software you already use, automate the repetitive work around your team, and help you find where AI is genuinely useful.
reassurance: Use one service or several. Nothing is bundled.

panel.heading: Most software comes with a built-in QuickBooks sync. When the built-in one makes a mess of the books, we build our own.
panel.result: Every connection checks that the numbers tie out. Anything that does not is flagged for review instead of landing in the books.
